description: Summarize complaints that owners filed with NHTSA for a vehicle by make, model and model year: total count, crashes, fires, injuries, the most-reported problem areas and the most recent complaint excerpts. Use when the user asks about common problems, reliability issues or what owners report about a car. Complaints are unverified owner reports, not confirmed defects.

model.description: Model name as sold in the US, e.g. Accord, F-150, Model 3

recent_limit.description: How many recent complaint excerpts to include (0-10)

name: get_vehicle_complaints
title: Get owner complaints
